reflect_en: The psalmist's love for God grew out of being heard: He has inclined His ear to me. As this week closes, look back at the prayers He has listened to, and let that give you courage to keep calling on Him as long as you live.
q_en: What prayer has God heard and answered for you lately?
x_en: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
tiktok: He leans in when you pray 🙏 Psalm 116:1–2 — He has inclined His ear to me
yt_title: He Has Heard My Voice | Psalm 116:1–2 #Shorts
li_open: People remember the leaders who actually listened.
li_quote: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
li_body: The psalmist kept praying because God had inclined His ear to him. In our churches, ministries and teams, listening well is how trust grows: when people know their needs are heard and prayed for, they keep bringing them.
reflect_es: El amor del salmista nació de saberse escuchado: ha inclinado a mí su oído. Al terminar esta semana, recuerda las oraciones que Dios ha escuchado y anímate a seguir invocándole en todos tus días.
q_es: ¿Qué oración te ha escuchado Dios últimamente?
x_es: Amo a Jehová, pues ha oído mi voz y mis súplicas.
key_en: He has inclined His ear to me
key_es: ha inclinado a mí su oído
